trinkets.name: Pocket Watch
trinkets.desc: Displays on screen when Night will begin and how long it will last.

trinkets.name: Sprinkler Pocket
trinkets.desc: Adds a dedicated Sprinkler inventory slot.

trinkets.name: Starflower Compass
trinkets.desc: Notifies you when a Starflower spawns.

trinkets.name: Book of Preservation
trinkets.desc: Increases duration for Abilities and Items by 20% and 10%.
trinkets.extra: Abilities last 20% longer and Items last 10% longer.

trinkets.name: Candy Bucket
trinkets.desc: While equipped, Candy Treats drop from gathering pollen and defeating mobs.
trinkets.extra: Limited trinket tied to the Hollow Moon event. Game data also lists a 5-Ticket cost and marks it as a statue.

trinkets.name: Pocket Blender
trinkets.desc: Allows you to use the blender wherever you are on the map, and will have a cooldown.

trinkets.name: Bribe Treats
trinkets.desc: Lets you pick a discovered bee to guarantee the next time its rarity is rolled from a Royal Jelly.

trinkets.name: Clover Charms
trinkets.desc: Has a 25% chance to double your Luck for mob loot.
trinkets.extra: The resulting Clover Charm boost lasts 15 minutes.

trinkets.name: Tele-Sphere
trinkets.desc: Teleports you to your hive whenever you are on the map.
